verdict.reason: 89.2% of the clock's weight is present -- materially reduced; predictions are partially intercept-driven and must be read with care

reproduction.reason: no known-age fibroblast set available (pass its dir)

in_range.reason: in-range contrast +18.0 yr for a 21 yr true gap, Spearman +0.60 over 4 in-range donors; 2 donors are OUT of range (1.0, 96.0)

intercept_dominance.reason: predictions have SD 21.4 yr around a 72.4 yr intercept

denominator_sensitivity.reason: switching the CP10k gene space moves predicted age by 4.3 yr on average

attribution.reason: the rise is spread across genes with no dominant category; inconclusive on H3, weight the other checks

decision.reason: the clock tracks in-range adult fibroblast age (H2 confirmed), so 'the clock can't read age' is too strong. The reprogramming-phase behaviour needs the attribution check to finish before choosing between a domain fix and a new target.
